title: fix(spec): bump PROTOCOL_VERSION 12→13 to match spec major (unblock main CI)
body:
## Problem

`main`'s CI is red. The version-packages roll (#2720) took `@objectstack/spec` to major **13.0.0** but left `PROTOCOL_VERSION` at **12.0.0**. `packages/spec/src/kernel/protocol-version.test.ts` — the lockstep guard that asserts the protocol major equals the package major — now fails:

```
FAIL protocol-version.test.ts > stays in lockstep with the package major (no drift)
AssertionError: expected 12 to be 13
```

This reddens **Test Core** on every open PR (e.g. #2721), not just here.

## Fix

Bump `PROTOCOL_VERSION` `12.0.0 → 13.0.0` so the loader/installer handshake advertises the major the package actually ships. One-line source change + changeset.

## Verification

- `packages/spec` full suite (CI-faithful `pnpm run test`): **6672 passed / 247 files** — the previously-failing test is green, zero regressions (matches CI's `6672` total).
- Repo-wide scan: no `engines.protocol` pins or `PROTOCOL_MAJOR === 12` assertions anywhere, so nothing depended on the old value.
